name: minValue
label: Min value
description: Start value of the gauge scale. If not set defined automatically.

name: maxValue
label: Max value
description: End value of the gauge scale. If not set defined automatically.

name: innerRadius
label: Inner radius
description: Decimal number to set the ratio of inner radius to outer radius of the gauge chart. Allowed value from 0.7 to 0.95.

name: valueLabelSize
label: Value label size
description: Sets the size of the value label.

name: scoreLabel
label: Score label
description: Defines what should be shown in the secondary label above score value.

name: showZero
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration

name: chartSize
label: Chart size
description: Sets the size of the chart.

name: showLabelFirst
label: Show label as primary
description: Changes placing of score and label. Should be used to emphasize e.g. the range label over exact value of the score.

name: showRangeLimit
label: Show range limit
description: Shows the range limits values at the chart.

name: showRegister
label: Show legend
description: Toggles the display of the legend on the visualization.

name: registerPosition
label: Legend position
description: Legend location relative to the chart.

name: registerOrientation
label: Legend orientation
description: Determines the layout of the legend within the visualization.

name: legendHorizontalAlignment
label: Horizontal alignment
description: Horizontal alignment of elements in the legend.

name: legendMaxItemWidth
label: Max legend item width, px
description: Defines number of pixels after which the item of the legend will be truncated.
